pooled_caveat: The packet spans distinct labor institutions and periods, and includes some economic or occupational policies that do not amount to a comprehensive labor platform.
pooled_summary: Historical claims address organizing, collective bargaining, unions, strikes, wages, workplace standards, labor-law enforcement, and worker power. Democratic and DSA documents generally support stronger organizing rights and protections, while Republican documents include right-to-work, secret-ballot, and union-accountability positions.
qualification: Source-bound assistant synthesis of period- and document-diverse central examples, not independent human certification or an exhaustive stance classification. Statements describe the observed documents across years, not every member's beliefs or a current consensus.
title: Labor Rights, Unionization, and Worker Protections
